messages:
Micah: Quick sync — proposing a focused chaos run next Wed to validate preemptible strategy and stay within our monthly spot budget. Who's in?
Anya: In. We should define the interruption budget + success criteria first. :+1:
Sanjay: I'll join. Want tail latency on generation + embeddings.
Leo: I can own the canary cluster and routing.
Micah: Initial interruption budget: 10% GPU capacity in eu-west-1 over 30m windows, max 2x/wk per pool. Cost target: spot >= 60% of GPU spend without SLA hits.
Anya: Proposed success criteria:
- p95 latency change < 20% vs baseline
- error rate increase < 0.5% absolute
- 95% of evicted tasks recovered <= 3m
- no customer-facing throttles
Sanjay: Add: queued requests growth <= 30% during peak
Micah: Run plan:
1) Canary: 5% evictions on canary pool (30m)
2) Scale: mixed pool 30m, evictions up to 10%
3) Full: staged region runs with rollback gates
Anya: Abort gates:
- If p95 > baseline * 1.4 -> abort and route to reserved
- If error rate +2% absolute -> abort
- If warm-pool can't absorb in 5m -> abort
Leo: Reminder: warm pools 10% fleet per region, autoscale cooldown 60s, drain timeout 45s.
Micah: Eviction commands (ops host):
```
# AWS: terminate by tag
aws ec2 describe-instances --filters "Name=tag:pool,Values=preemptible" --query "Reservations[].Instances[][InstanceId]" --output text | xargs -n1 aws ec2 terminate-instances --instance-ids
# k8s: delete pods gracefully
kubectl -n infra get pods -l pool=preemptible -o name | xargs -r -n1 kubectl delete --grace-period=30
```
Sanjay: Also test GPU driver kill on canary node to simulate abrupt device loss.
Anya: Observability checklist:
- 1h baseline capture (p50/p95/p99, errors)
- enable eviction trace tag
- ensure datadog metrics: preempt.evictions, preempt.recover_time, warm_pool.util
Micah: Ops notes: Advise EU customers 24h prior; mark maintenance window. Oncall: Anya + Leo primary.
Leo: I'll spin a dashboard + a single-panel abort button.
Anya: Post-run: 1h retro in #eng-infra, 24h deep dive doc, capture cost delta + reg test failures.
Micah: Please add one-liner in playbook: "how to shift traffic to reserved pool" (commands + IAM owners). I'll collate.
evict-bot: scheduled eviction job created: run_id=chaos-2026-07-21-01, target=eu-west-1, start=2026-07-21T16:00:00Z
Micah: Locked. Meeting invite with runbook + dashboard in 10m. :rocket:
